name: Mega Electronics
old_description: MEGA Electronics Inc. was founded in 1994 to provide one source for all components that bring power from the wall into your product, for any location, anywhere in the world. MEGA has emerged as the preferred partner for commercial and industrial use Power Supplies and Cords. The currently available products in this category include wall mount, desktop, DIN rail and open frame power supplies. All in Level VI, mandatory as of 2/2016
about:
Mega Electronics Inc. operates from New Brunswick, New Jersey. Founded in 1984, the company began with the goal of supplying a single source for components that deliver power from the wall into electronic products for any global location. No founders are named in public records, and ownership structure has not been disclosed.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes power cords, power supplies, and DC/DC converters. Its power supply line spans wall-mount, desktop, DIN-rail, and open-frame formats from 5 W to 960 W, carrying UL, CSA, CE, CCC, CB, and other global safety marks. DC/DC converters range from 0.25 W to 200 W in through-hole, surface-mount, and chassis-mount packages. Mega also produces IEC Lock locking connectors, EN60309 industrial plugs, anti-microbial cables, twist-lock extension cords up to 30 A, and card-edge connectors that mate directly to printed circuit boards. An ISO 9001-certified production facility supports these lines, and a U.S. warehouse enables stock shipment worldwide. The firm offers vendor-managed inventory (VMI), just-in-time (JIT), and kanban programs for blanket and stock-and-release orders.

Mega serves commercial and industrial markets including medical equipment, data centers, computer peripherals, food-service machinery, industrial equipment, networking hardware, and vending machines. Its power cords hold approvals for North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, South America, and the Middle East, allowing customers to ship products globally without separate cord qualifications.

The company cites three pillars—high-quality products, excellent customer service, and superior product knowledge—as its foundation. It emphasizes single-stop shopping for power components, worldwide approval expertise, dedicated engineering support from concept through product life cycle, and a stock-based fulfillment model backed by VMI, JIT, and kanban services.
